caseNameFull: Land v. Dollar and In re Killion
attorneys: Attorney General McGranery for Land et al., petitioners in No. 1., Arthur B. Dunne for petitioner in No. 2., Herman Phleger, Gregory A. Harrison, Moses Lasky, Edmund L. Jones and Howard Boyd for Dollar et al., respondents.

opinions.text:
On writs of certiorari, 341 U. S. 737, to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Dismissed on motions of counsel for petitioners.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
